general_information.Description: This course based on the C# Programming for Unity Game Development Specialization at https://www.coursera.org/specializations/programming-unity-game-development. The course is all about starting to learn how to develop video games using the C# programming language and the Unity game engine on Windows or Mac. C# is a really good language for learning how to program and then programming professionally. Also, the Unity game engine is very popular with indie game developers; Unity games were downloaded 16,000,000,000 times in 2016! Finally, C# is one of the programming languages you can use in the Unity environment. This course doesn't assume students have any previous programming experience. Students will start at the very beginning and work our way up to building small games by the end of the course. Throughout the course student'll learn core programming concepts that apply to lots of programming languages, including C#, and also learn how to apply those concepts when you develop games.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU LMS at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Know how to write and run your C# console application
Know how to store data in programs
Know how to use classes and objects to implement code
Know the basics of Unity 2D games
Know how to use decision structures in code
Know how to get and use player input in Unity games
Know how to store lots of data in arrays and lists and apply iteration (looping) to repeat actions in code
Know abstraction and apply it to design and implement console application classes
Apply abstraction to design and implement Unity classes
Know how to add text output and sound effects to Unity games
